adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/requestReschedule.handler.ts`, the rewritten `destinationCalendar` assignment only wraps `bookingToReschedule?.destinationCalendar` in an array and otherwise falls back to `[]`:
```ts
destinationCalendar: bookingToReschedule?.destinationCalendar ? [bookingToReschedule?.destinationCalendar] : [],
```
This preserves the prior copy/paste issue (previously `bookingToReschedule?.destinationCalendar || bookingToReschedule?.destinationCalendar`) by still lacking the `user.destinationCalendar` fallback that many sibling handlers in this diff now apply (e.g. `confirm.handler.ts`, `editLocation.handler.ts`, `deleteCredential.handler.ts`). That means reschedule requests will lose a valid destination calendar when the booking lacks one but the user has a default, causing inconsistent and potentially incorrect calendar behavior.
